audio_selection: DIRECTOR_SPECIFIED; actual outputs require listening/licence review

menu.style: light martial wood/hand percussion, restrained strings, no vocals

battle.style: clear marching percussion and short brass/strings, no vocals, space for impacts

music.loop_edit: trim/fade and musically align actual mastered output; AI track duration is not assumed exact
music.runtime: Unity compressed streaming music; keep source masters; seamless boundary must be listened to

sfx.master_format: WAV48kHz24-bit mono; stereo only for UI/reward/base destruction when useful
sfx.runtime: short effects preloaded/decompressed; no streaming delay for impacts
sfx.priority: purchase/save warnings > fortress end > player command/Rally > major hit > ordinary hit > ambience
sfx.sfx_loudness: do not normalize every effect to equal perceived loudness; preserve impact hierarchy; mix must not clip

vfx.reduced_motion: no camera shake, no decorative UI overshoot; preserve gameplay cues
vfx.reduced_flashes: remove full-sprite bright flashes; use outline/contact movement instead
vfx.criticality: Simulation projectiles/health remain independent; pool exhaustion drops decorative work first

art_import.format: lossless transparent PNG masters; final mobile compression after alpha/colour inspection, without changing geometry
art_import.empty_alpha_margins: retained logical registration or explicit pivot metadata; no auto-crop that moves joints
art_import.font_source: Preferred display Roboto Slab ExtraBold, functional Inter SemiBold/Bold, Noto Sans fallback. Font licenses must be obtained and retained by implementer; no font binaries are distributed in this source pack.
